Lemma
[Evolution of the $M$-tensor] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0301, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0302, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0303, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0304 ↗ def:chow-ii-harnack-p-and-m-tensors ↗ lem:chow-ii-evolution-of-p-tensor 1. ch15:15.19\group Harnack Evolution Equations

\[ egin{aligned} ( abla _t-\Delta )M_{ab}={}& 2R_{acdb}M_{cd} +2R_{cd}( abla _cP_{dab}+ abla _cP_{dba})\ & +P_{cda}P_{cdb}-2P_{acd}P_{bdc} +2R_{cd}R_{ce}R_{adeb}- rac1{2t^2}R_{ab}. \end{aligned} \]
Proof

\sketch Contracted Bianchi and one commutation give

\[ M_{ab}= abla _cP_{cab}+R_{acdb}R_{cd}+ rac1{2t}R_{ab}. \]

Apply $ abla _t-\Delta $. Use Lemma 4, the curvature and Ricci evolution equations, and commute the derivative in $ abla _cP_{cab}$. The derivative terms combine into the displayed $2R_{cd}( abla _cP_{dab}+ abla _cP_{dba})$; the quadratic derivative terms combine into $P_{cda}P_{cdb}-2P_{acd}P_{bdc}$; the algebraic curvature terms combine into the first and penultimate terms. Differentiating $1/(2t)$ supplies the final term.

□
